input.command:
git add src/cargo/hazmat.ts && git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
Fix hazmat segregation check for classes with divisions

The segregation check was failing to match hazard classes with divisions
(like 5.1, 5.2) against the segregation table. The issue was that the
lookup only tried the primary class (e.g., "5") but the table contains
entries for both primary classes and full classes with divisions.

Now the function:
1. Tries to look up both the full class and primary class in the table
2. Compares not just exact matches but also checks if any entry has the
   same primary class as the target class

This allows all hazmat segregation rules to be correctly enforced.
Co-Authored-By: Claude Haiku 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)"

content.text:
Fixed INC-86! The issue was that hazmat classes with divisions (like "5.1") weren't being matched against the segregation table because the function only checked for primary class lookups.

The fix modifies `mustSegregate()` to:
1. Try looking up both the full class name and primary class in the SEGREGATION table
2. Compare not just exact matches but also classes with the same primary class

All acceptance criteria now pass:
- ✅ mustSegregate("1", "5.1") → true
- ✅ mustSegregate("5.1", "1") → true  
- ✅ mustSegregate("2.1", "5.1") → true
- ✅ mustSegregate("5.2", "3") → true
- ✅ mustSegregate("3", "8") → false
- ✅ mustSegregate("8", "5.1") → false
- ✅ adjacentConflicts now reports violations correctly

Existing tests continue to pass.
